title: Sentinel Retention Reduction of ClearPath Exit Fees
content:
The security-retention reduction of the early termination fee of a ClearPath Managed IT Services agreement reads the term end date of the client's active Sentinel Managed Security subscription and counts the calendar days from the termination effective date to it:
- 365 days or more take 15.0 percent off;
- zero up to 364 days take 7.0 percent off;
- a subscription ending before the termination effective date, or no active subscription, takes nothing off.

| Sentinel Managed Security subscription | Calendar days from the termination effective date to its term end | Reduction |
|---|---|---|
| active | 365 or more | 15.0 percent |
| active | 0 to 364 | 7.0 percent |
| active | ends before the termination effective date | nothing |
| none active | | nothing |

**Hypothetical cases, termination effective 2025-08-31.** Sentinel term ending 2026-08-31: 365 days, 15.0 percent off. Ending 2026-08-30: 364 days, 7.0 percent off. Ending 2025-08-31: zero days, 7.0 percent off. Ending 2025-08-30: nothing.
